# Forrof

> Forrof is a software, AI and growth marketing agency with a focus on law firms (LegalTech) and agriculture (AgriTech). A 17-person team builds custom software, AI automation and system integrations, and runs SEO and paid ads for clients worldwide. Prices are quoted in USD with a fixed quote before work starts.

## Services

- [AI & Automation](https://forrof.io/services/ai-automation): AI agents, document automation, RAG assistants and workflow automation.
- [Custom Software Development](https://forrof.io/services/custom-software): Web apps, client portals, SaaS products and mobile apps.
- [Systems Integration & Data](https://forrof.io/services/systems-integration): Xero and API integrations, data pipelines and dashboards.
- [SEO & AI Search Visibility](https://forrof.io/services/seo): Technical SEO, local SEO and AI search optimisation.
- [Performance Marketing](https://forrof.io/services/performance-marketing): Google, Meta and LinkedIn ads with conversion tracking.

## Industries

- [LegalTech & Law Firms](https://forrof.io/industries/legaltech): Client portals, document automation, e-signature, private legal AI and practice management integrations.
- [Agriculture & AgriTech](https://forrof.io/industries/agriculture): Farm management software, offline field apps, John Deere and Climate FieldView integrations, compliance reporting and support.
